items.title: Pseudo-coherence over a Noetherian ring via finiteness of cohomology
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises m-pseudo-coherence and pseudo-coherence of a complex over a Noetherian ring by boundedness above together with finiteness of the cohomology modules in the relevant degrees, and deduces that a module is pseudo-coherent exactly when it is finite. The proof first combines the standard fact that finite modules are pseudo-coherent with the statement that pseudo-coherent modules are finite to settle the module case, then reads off finiteness of the cohomology from the bounded complex of finite free modules provided by m-pseudo-coherence, and obtains the converse from the cohomology-by-cohomology criterion.
